culture.hearth.name.2: the Folk of the Kept Fire
culture.reed.name.2: the Folk of the Low Water
culture.night.name.1: the Folk of the Long Dark
faith.roots.name.2: the Faith of the Deep Root
god.cares.oaths: hates a broken promise and loves a kept one
god.cares.hearth: hates a stolen meal or a wronged guest, and loves food shared
god.cares.vein: hates blood refused and loves blood given
god.cares.grove: hates a felled tree and loves food shared
custom.clasp_greeting.name: the clasped arm
custom.clasp_greeting.rule: Clasps forearms in greeting, and is slighted by anyone who will not.
custom.no_touch_greeting.name: no touch at meeting
custom.no_touch_greeting.rule: Does not touch someone they have just met.
custom.bow_greeting.name: the bow of greeting
custom.bow_greeting.rule: Bows before speaking to someone new.
custom.veiled_greeting.name: the lowered eyes
custom.blood_taboo.name: the blood taboo
custom.blood_taboo.rule: Will not give blood, except to someone dear to them.
custom.blood_gift.name: the blood-gift
custom.blood_gift.rule: Gives blood to the undying gladly.
custom.guest_bread.name: guest-bread
custom.guest_bread.rule: Gives a guest their own meal, or finds them one, if the camp has none to spare.
custom.leader_last.name: the leader eats last
custom.leader_last.rule: Expects a leader to eat last.
custom.debt_of_honour.name: debts of honour
custom.debt_of_honour.rule: Repays what they owe with food when their creditor is hungry.
custom.harvest_fire.name: the harvest fire
custom.harvest_fire.rule: Lights the harvest fire in autumn, and sets down a grudge there.
custom.longest_night.name: the Longest Night
custom.longest_night.rule: Keeps the Longest Night in winter, and sets down a grudge there.
custom.sacred_grove.name: the sacred tree
custom.sacred_grove.rule: Will not fell the old tree sacred to their faith.
event.culture.clasp_greeting.breach: {a} would not clasp {b}'s arm in greeting; to {ways}, that is a slight.
event.culture.clasp_greeting.breach_you_: {a} would not clasp your arm in greeting; to {ways}, that is a slight.
event.culture.no_touch_greeting.breach: {a} took {b} by the hand at their first meeting; {ways} do not touch a stranger.
event.culture.no_touch_greeting.breach_y: {a} took {b} by the hand at your first meeting; {ways} do not touch a stranger.
{a} took {b} by the hand at your first meeting; {ways} do not touch a stranger.
event.culture.bow_greeting.breach: {a} spoke to {b} without first bowing; {ways} take that as rudeness.
event.culture.veiled_greeting.breach: {a} looked {b} full in the eyes at their first meeting; to {ways}, that is a challenge.
event.culture.veiled_greeting.breach_you: {a} looked {b} full in the eyes at your first meeting; to {ways}, that is a challenge.

event.culture.blood_taboo.refused: {b} refused to give {a} blood; {ways} forbid it.
event.culture.guest_bread.shared: {a} gave up their own meal for {b}, as {ways} do for a guest.
event.culture.guest_bread.shared_you_a: {a} gave up your own meal for {b}, as {ways} do for a guest.
event.culture.guest_bread.foraged: With nothing to spare in the stores, {a} went out and found {b} something to eat, as {ways} do for a guest.
event.culture.guest_bread.wronged: {b} had come as a guest; {ways} do not forgive a broken promise to a guest.
event.culture.word_spread: Word that {a} broke a promise spread among {ways}.
event.culture.leader_last.offended: {a} went without while {b} ate; among {ways}, a leader eats last.
event.culture.leader_last.honoured: {a} saw {b} go without so others could eat; among {ways}, that is how a leader is known.
event.culture.debt_of_honour.repaid: {a} brought {b} food to settle what they owed, as {ways} do.
event.culture.debt_of_honour.repaid_you_: {a} brought {b} food to settle what you owed, as {ways} do.
event.culture.harvest_fire.begins: At dusk {ways} lit the harvest fire and shared {n} {item} among the camp.
event.culture.harvest_fire.begins_lean: At dusk {ways} lit the harvest fire, though there was nothing to spare for a feast.
event.culture.harvest_fire.forgave: At the harvest fire, {a} set down their grudge against {b}.
event.culture.harvest_fire.forgave_you_a: At the harvest fire, {a} set down your grudge against {b}.
event.culture.longest_night.begins: At dusk {ways} began to keep the Longest Night by the hearth.
event.culture.longest_night.forgave: On the Longest Night, {a} set down their grudge against {b}.
event.culture.longest_night.forgave_you_: On the Longest Night, {a} set down your grudge against {b}.
event.culture.sacred_grove.desecrated: {a} felled the old tree sacred to {ways}.

thought.guest_bread_received: Was given a host's own meal
thought.heard_oath_broken: Heard that someone broke their word

thought.leader_ate_last: Our leader went without so we could eat
